description: Browse the MPP32 federated catalog of 4,500+ machine-payable APIs and data services. Includes native MPP32 services (callable end-to-end through this MCP), the x402 Bazaar (USDC on Solana), curated free APIs (DexScreener, Jupiter, CoinGecko health, httpbin, etc.), and the public MCP Registry (npx-installable servers; listing-only). Each result indicates whether it is callable through `call_mpp32_endpoint` or listing-only. The catalog is large (~4,500 entries) — by default a single call returns up to 100 results and the response will tell you the true total and whether the page was truncated. Use `q` (free-text search), `category`, `source`, or `protocol` to narrow down, or raise `limit` (max 500) for broader pages.

protocol.description: Filter by payment protocol (e.g. 'x402' for USDC-settled services).

q.description: Free-text search across name, description, tags, and category.

source.description: Filter by catalog source. 'native' = callable end-to-end; 'curated'/'free' = often callable; 'x402-bazaar'/'mcp-registry' = mostly listing-only.

name: list_mpp32_services
